mapper.select: SELECT o.id AS orderId, o.restaurant_id AS restaurantId, r.name AS restaurantName, r.logo_url AS restaurantLogo, o.total_amount AS totalAmount, o.status AS status, o.created_time AS createdTime FROM orders o JOIN restaurant r ON o.restaurant_id = r.id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND ( r.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.id AND oi.dish_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ) ORDER BY o.created_time DESC

SELECT r.id AS restaurantId, r.name AS restaurantName,
DATE(o.created_time) AS timeKey
YEARWEEK(o.created_time) AS timeKey
DATE_FORMAT(o.created_time, '%Y-%m') AS timeKey
,
COUNT(o.id) AS orderCount, SUM(o.total_amount) AS totalSales,
( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o2 ON oi.order_id = o2.id WHERE o2.restaurant_id = r.id AND o2.status = 6
AND o2.created_time >= #{startDate}
AND o2.created_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
) AS totalItemsSold
FROM orders o JOIN restaurant r ON o.restaurant_id = r.id
o.status = 6
AND o.restaurant_id = #{restaurantId}
AND o.created_time >= #{startDate}
AND o.created_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY r.id, timeKey ORDER BY timeKey ASC
SELECT restaurant_id AS restaurantId, COUNT(*) AS monthlySales FROM orders WHERE status = 6 AND DATE(created_time) BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY restaurant_id
